_meta.description: D6 fixtures for langgraph-python / a2ui-recovery (A2UI error recovery)
_meta._note: Backend-owned A2UI (get_a2ui_tools, injectA2UITool=false). No context gate: observed inner requests carry no x-aimock-context or x-test-id. Context-free matchers remain eligible for any integration with matching request content; prompt wording is not an isolation boundary. The HEAL/EXHAUST prompts are also present in built-in-agent/a2ui-recovery.json. The user prompt plus toolName=render_a2ui separates inner requests from outer generate_a2ui calls. HEAL: invalid dangling child -> validator feedback -> valid surface (declarative-metric x2). EXHAUST: invalid on every attempt -> a2ui_recovery_exhausted. Retry matching uses request feedback, not shared sequence counters; outer narration matches the scenario prompt, offered generate_a2ui tool, and current-turn tool result (hasToolResult=true). Verified local runtime: ag-ui-langgraph 0.0.41 with ag-ui-a2ui-toolkit 0.0.4. The toolkit recovery.py format_validation_errors/augment_prompt_with_validation_errors produces the [code] path: message feedback and retry header; ag_ui_langgraph/a2ui_tool.py sends that prompt as SystemMessage. These are observed versions, not a proven minimum or compatibility promise for later versions.

fixtures._comment: HEAL pill - inner render_a2ui retry after the missing-metric validation error: VALID surface (Column + two Metric tiles). Match request feedback rather than shared sequence counters so repeated heal requests recover independently. This feedback gate is load-bearing: if it misses, the generic invalid HEAL entry can repeat and exhaust like EXHAUST. Diagnose the actual selected fixture and retry prompt; the HEAL metric assertion must still pass.
